name: MOT_TERR_FACT_DN
description: This table stores denormalized view of Fact along with the associated dimension member.

columns.name: TERR_FACT_DN_ID
columns.description: Primary key.

columns.name: PARTITION_ID
columns.description: Identifier for dimension partition.

columns.name: FACT_ID
columns.description: Identifier for fact.

columns.name: GEO_INTG_ID
columns.description: Identifier for geography dimension member associated to the fact

columns.name: ACCT_INTG_ID
columns.description: Identifier for account dimension member associated to the fact.

columns.name: ACTYP_INTG_ID
columns.description: Identifier for account type dimension member associated to the fact.

columns.name: CSIZE_INTG_ID
columns.description: Identifier for customer size dimension member associated to the fact.

columns.name: INDST_INTG_ID
columns.description: Identifier for industry dimension member associated to the fact.

columns.name: AUX1_INTG_ID
columns.description: Identifier for auxiliary 1 dimension member associated to the fact.

columns.name: AUX2_INTG_ID
columns.description: Identifier for auxiliary 2 dimension member associated to the fact.

columns.name: AUX3_INTG_ID
columns.description: Identifier for auxiliary 3 dimension member associated to the fact.

columns.name: ORGTP_INTG_ID
columns.description: Identifier for organization type dimension member associated to the fact.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
